tool_args.rationale: The pilot and branch probe establish nonlinear input and gradient dependence but leave the two-hop temporal mechanism unidentifiable at a single horizon. A fine trajectory batch can distinguish candidate dynamics before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating snapshot model to the seven rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations share the same horizon, past input, initial state, and memory, so they cannot identify the temporal bridge or its dependence on those variables.
The acquired branch observations already vary the gradient; temporal trajectory information is the more relevant remaining ambiguity.
It does not resolve the bridge dynamics.
